pr.title: Add polyglot Azure provisioning proxy SDKs
pr.author: sebastienros

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: All failing tests time out waiting for the pwa-msedge/Blazor WASM debug child session to attach during Windows browser-debugger E2E tests. This matches a well-known, high-frequency flaky failure pattern (14 prior occurrences tracked in cause 'vscode-extension-e2e-unrelated-logs-unavailable', issue #19618) unrelated to this PR's changes, which only touch Azure provisioning proxy SDK generation code with no relation to the VS Code extension debugger E2E harness.
